game.name: Spider-man 3 (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Spider-Man 3 on Xbox 360 is an action game in which you obviously play as Peter Parker, half-man, half-spider, who transforms into Spider-Man to save the widow and the orphan. The game takes up the story of the third film and allows you to wander around the city, from web to web, looking for all the missions to be carried out.
